messages.subject: could not find function "as.character.shiny.tag"
parts:
Migrating from shiny 0.8.0 to 0.10.0 I get the following error message when I run the app.
Unfortunately this is all I got, sorry for the sparse information.
I do not have a clue where in the app the problem might occur.

Error in format.shiny.tag.list(tagList(HTML("<!--[if lt IE 9]>"), tags$script(src = "shared/selectize/js/es5-shim.min.js"),  : 
  could not find function "as.character.shiny.tag"

Any ideas?
TIA
Mark

messages.subject: Re: could not find function "as.character.shiny.tag"

library(shiny);sessionInfo() please. I'm not sure how you installed
shiny, but it looks like its dependency htmltools was not installed
for some reason.

Regards,
Yihui
